composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Keep the formations compact in the lower two-thirds and the upper sky clean gray-blue, with no people, ruins, or artificial structures. Vertical 1024x1536 for a phone wallpaper.
